{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df_clean['status'] == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Group by channel and customer_segment, compute mean revenue
grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue_float'].mean()

# Now compute the difference in average revenue within each segment
# This is the correct way to adjust for customer_segment

# Extract the means for each segment
differences = []
for segment in grouped['customer_segment'].unique():
    email_revenue = grouped[(grouped['channel'] == 'email') & (grouped['customer_segment'] == segment)]['revenue_float'].iloc[0]
    paid_search_revenue = grouped[(grouped['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (grouped['customer_segment'] == segment)]['revenue_float'].iloc[0]
    diff = email_revenue - paid_search_revenue
    differences.append((segment, email_revenue, paid_search_revenue, diff))

# Convert to DataFrame for printing
diff_df = pd.DataFrame(differences, columns=['customer_segment', 'email_avg', 'paid_search_avg', 'difference'])

# Print results
print('Difference in average revenue per order by segment (email - paid_search):')
print(diff_df)

# Also print the overall unweighted average for context
channel_avg = grouped.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_float'].mean()
print('\nOverall average revenue per order by channel:')
print(channel_avg)"}
